ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; approximately 85% low-intensity (black) pixels to 15% high-intensity (white) pixels on the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity base across both lobes. Distinct high-intensity white pixel clusters are concentrated at the lateral distal tips. Scattered, roughly circular white focal spots are distributed across the medial and lateral surfaces of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped depression with an approximate internal angle of 45-50 degrees and a vertical depth roughly 15% of the visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations (peaks and valleys) along the entire trailing edge; pixel amplitude of serrations is most pronounced on the right lobe and medial sections near the notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex mathematical curve fitted to the trailing edges, sweeping symmetrically from the notch toward the upward-tilted tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple high-contrast circular pixel clusters; prominent group of 4-5 rosettes on the far left tip and a dense cluster on the upper mid-right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, unaligned high-intensity linear disruptions on the right lobe, including a long diagonal mark (~30% of lobe width) and smaller parallel rake marks.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent linear rake marks on the right lobe and numerous circular depigmented scars (consistent with parasitic or barnacle attachment sites) across both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique, high-intensity white mottling pattern confined to the extreme lateral margins of the fluke tips.
